Good Afternoon Fadi,

We sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding the rate shared earlier.

Please note that there was a small correction required to the quoted rate. The previously shared rate of AED 8,000 was applicable only for the month of August.

As your booking is now planned to start from September, the rate has been revised based on the current availability and market conditions.

We truly appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this adjustment may cause. We will share the updated rates with you shortly.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
